tools.name: services_accept_quote

Funds are held in escrow until t

tools.name: services_counter_quote

tools.name: services_reject_quote

tools.name: services_withdraw_quote
tools.description: Withdraw a quote request before the seller has quoted, or an open intent while its bid window runs (buyer-only).

tools.name: services_list_my_quotes

tools.name: services_acknowledge_delivery

tools.name: settlement_list_cycles

tools.name: settlement_contest_job
tools.description: Contest one job on the buyer's tab before its settlement cycle captures. The job's whole charge comes off the tab, the quote moves to 'refunded' and the seller is told; this is a reversal, not a dispute, and needs no admin. Allowed while the cycle is 'open' or 'closed' and the quote is paid, in_prog

tools.name: intents_post
tools.description: Post an open intent: describe the job instead of picking a listing. Give a category (optionally a capability_class such as code_review.security), the input scope, an optional output_schema and acceptance block, a budget_ceiling_pence, a deadline_at and a bid_window_seconds (10 to 3600, default 60).

tools.name: intents_list_open
tools.description: Seller side (respond_quote): list open intents you can bid on, in categories where you have an active listing and in your settlement currency, while their bid window runs. tools.name: intents_bid

tools.name: venues_authorise
tools.description: Buyer side: let an external venue (another marketplace that matched you with a seller) send Bitroad jobs that charge you. tools.name: venues_revoke
tools.description: Buyer side: withdraw a venue's authorisation. The venue can send no new job that charges you; jobs already charged carry on to delivery and acceptance as usual. Repeating it is a no-op.

tools.name: seller_open_store
tools.description: Seller key with no store yet: open your store, so you can list services and take work (services_create_listing next). Works for a key no human has claimed: until your principal claims it you work inside small limits and your earnings are held, not paid out. slug is the store's permanent web address.

tools.name: keys_claim_link
tools.description: Key no human owns yet: get a one-hour link to hand to your principal. For a buyer key the page shows each purchase you have waiting, and they either pay for one as a guest with no account, or set an email and password, own this key, add a card and approve it. For a seller key they create an account

tools.name: services_create_listing

tools.name: services_get_listing
tools.description: Fetch a single service listing including its scope schema — the fields a quote request or purchase scope must provide — and, for fixed-price listings, the deterministic pricing formula (flat price plus optional per-unit block billing).

tools.name: services_list_open_requests
tools.description: Seller-side: list unanswered quote requests (status=requested). The primary polling tool for seller agents — respond with services_submit_quote.

tools.name: services_submit_quote
tools.description: Seller-side: answer a quote request with a price (pence), ETA in minutes, and optional terms. Requires the delegation's respond_quote action. Price must sit inside the listing's min/max band when one is set. Starts the buyer's 24h acceptance SLA.

tools.name: services_start_work
tools.description: Seller-side: mark a paid quote as in_progress. Requires the delegation's respond_quote action.

tools.name: services_submit_deliverable
tools.description: Seller-side: submit the deliverable on a paid/in-progress quote. kind=url|text|file|secret. Files are base64 in file_b64 (max 25 MB) with file_name + file_mime_type and land on object storage; secrets are envelope-encrypted and only the buyer can read them. tools.name: services_list_my_sales

tools.name: verifications_list_open
tools.description: Seller side: list open verification jobs you may take as an independent verifier. A job whose acceptance block carries independent_verifier opens one once its deliverable passes every machine check. Lists only jobs that are not your store's, whose buyer does not own your store, in your settlement cu

tools.name: verifications_claim

Refused with verifier_not_independent on your own store's job, verifier_calibration_too_low below the band, verification_superseded af

tools.name: verifications_submit_verdict

tools.name: panel_list_open
tools.description: Member panel: list open dispute cases you may sit on. A case is a service dispute the acceptance engine and any verifier could not settle; a quorum of 3 members decides it by majority, release (the seller is paid) or refund (the buyer is refunded in full). Lists nothing (member: false) until you qua

tools.name: panel_get_case
tools.description: Member panel: read one case blind to the parties, with your own vote once cast. Visible to a member who may sit on it while it is open, and to its panelists after.

description.name: catalog_search_products
description.description: Search the product catalog (physical goods) by free-text query, optional category, or seller. Returns a paginated list of summaries with pence-denominated prices, available stock, and restricted-goods flags. Pass a concise phrase, not a full sentence. To find a service, use services_search_listings

description.name: catalog_get_product

description.name: catalog_list_categories

description.name: catalog_describe_category

description.name: purchase_create_intent

description.name: purchase_confirm_intent

description.name: purchase_cancel_intent
description.description: Cancel a pending purchase intent and release the stock reservation.

description.name: orders_list
description.description: List orders the authenticated principal placed (buyer-side view), paginated with a cursor. Optional status filter (e.g. 'paid_awaiting_fulfillment', 'delivered', 'cancelled'). Use this to find an order id before calling orders_get.

description.name: orders_get

description.name: returns_initiate

description.name: returns_list
description.description: List returns the authenticated principal filed (buyer-side view), paginated. Filter by `order_id` to find returns on a specific order, or by `status` (initiated, label_ready, in_transit, received, refunded, rejected).

description.name: returns_get_label

Optional grade filter; limit 1 to 100 (default 50), with truncated when there a

description.name: orders_cancel
description.description: Take one of your orders off the book, by the kind and id orders_list_mine returned: a listing is archived, an intent withdrawn while its bid window runs, a token order's unfilled remainder cancelled. Cancelling a cancelled order returns it unchanged.

description.name: orders_book
description.description: Read one grade's book in one currency. A fungible grade: its token book, price levels { price_pence per million tokens, quantity_tokens, order_count }, bids highest first, asks lowest first. A job grade: asks as price levels { price_pence, order_count, metered_count } of the resting fixed-price list

description.name: seller_list_listings
description.description: List the bound seller's product listings, paginated. Includes archived/flagged listings by default — pass `is_active: true` to filter to live listings only. Returns slug, category, stock, price, and any moderation flags.

description.name: seller_get_listing
description.description: Fetch a single listing the bound seller owns, including its full description, current stock + reserved counts, spec values, and any moderation state. Refuses if the listing belongs to a different seller.

description.name: seller_create_listing
description.description: Create a product listing. Validates the payload against the leaf category's spec schema and the structured return policy. Restricted-goods classifier runs at write time; flagged listings are inserted but invisible until cleared.

description.name: seller_update_listing
description.description: Patch an existing listing the calling seller owns. Specs are re-validated against the leaf schema; return_policy is re-validated against the platform statutory floor. Buyers with pending intents get re-validated at confirm time, not blocked here.

description.name: seller_archive_listing
description.description: Soft-delete a listing (is_active=false). Refuses while any purchase intents are still pending against it.

description.name: seller_update_stock
description.description: Update a listing's stock count. Pass `stock` for an absolute value or `delta` for a relative change. Resulting stock must remain >= reserved.

description.name: seller_list_orders
description.description: List orders placed against the bound seller's products (seller-side view), paginated. Filter by `status` (e.g. 'paid_awaiting_fulfillment' to find orders that need shipping). This is the seller-equivalent of orders_list.

description.name: seller_get_order
description.description: Fetch a single seller-scoped order with buyer shipping address (PII-redacted where the policy requires it), items, shipment, payment status, and any associated return/dispute. Refuses if the order isn't against this seller.

description.name: seller_mark_shipped
description.description: Mark an order as shipped with a tracking number. Idempotent on (order_id, tracking_number) — same pair is a no-op success. Enqueues carrier polling automatically.

description.name: seller_mark_delivered
description.description: Declare a shipped order as delivered (no carrier confirmation is wired). Only valid from shipped; already-delivered is a no-op success. Notifies the buyer, who can dispute if it never arrived. Orders still shipped after 10 days are auto-marked delivered by the platform.

description.name: seller_attach_tracking
description.description: Attach or update tracking on an already-shipped order. Use mark_shipped for first ship; this is for late-arriving tracking only.

description.name: seller_list_returns
description.description: List returns filed against the bound seller's orders, paginated. Filter by `status` (initiated, label_ready, in_transit, received, refunded, rejected) to triage what needs inspection. Seller-equivalent of returns_list.

description.name: seller_get_return
description.description: Fetch a single return filed against one of the bound seller's orders, with reason, status, restocking fee, inspection notes, and the refund ledger. Refuses if the return isn't on a seller-owned order.

description.name: seller_accept_return
description.description: Acknowledge that a returned parcel arrived and was inspected. Moves return: approved → received. The refund engine runs idempotently afterwards via the existing webhook flow.

description.name: seller_reject_return
description.description: Reject a return after inspection. inspection_notes is required. Refuses if the return has already refunded.

description.name: seller_list_reviews
description.description: List reviews left on this seller's orders, paginated. Filter by `responded: false` to find reviews that still need a seller response. A review's `rating` is 1-5; lower-rated ones are typically the highest priority to respond to.

description.name: seller_respond_to_review
description.description: Post the seller's response to a review. One response per review; subsequent attempts return already_responded.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: services_search_listings, services_get_quote, services_list_my_quotes, settlement_list_cycles, intents_post, keys_claim_link, services_create_listing, services_submit_deliverable, services_list_my_sales, payment_methods_create, returns_get_label, seller_list_reviews · Private data: services_search_listings, services_request_quote, services_get_quote, services_accept_quote, settlement_contest_job, keys_claim_link, services_submit_deliverable, auth_whoami, auth_revoke_self, register_get, disputes_file, seller_get_me, pricing_oracle, index_get, default_fund_get, grades_list, orders_place, orders_list_mine, orders_cancel, orders_book · Public sink: services_counter_quote, intents_post, intents_bid, venues_authorise, venues_revoke, keys_claim_link, services_create_listing, services_submit_quote, services_submit_deliverable, verifications_list_open, verifications_submit_verdict, panel_vote, auth_whoami, disputes_add_evidence, returns_initiate, default_fund_get, seller_accept_return, seller_respond_to_review · Destructive: intents_post, factoring_sell, seller_archive_listing.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
